customManagers.description: beliq-cli is not a dependency of this repo, it is installed at run time by `npx`, so no manager reads the version this action pins. Without this the pin would freeze: the action would go on installing 0.2.2 forever while the CLI moved on, which is worse than the floating `latest` it replaced. The version is written in three places (action.yml's cli-version default, DEFAULT_CLI_VERSION in runner.mjs, and the npx call that builds the live smoke's fixture in test-action.yml) and each carries the marker comment this matches, so all three move in one PR. test/runner.test.js checks this regex against all three files, so a file that loses its marker reds the build instead of quietly dropping out of the manager.
